author: GameTrailers
description:
Dive! Punch! Catch! Sea Sniffers is a unique take on collecting fish where you play as a seal that throws a mean punch. Check out the Sea Sniffers announcement trailer for this upcoming game to see gameplay, characters, and more. Sea Sniffers will be available on Steam in 2027.

In Sea Sniffers, explore sunken ships, uncover hidden caves, and meet the ocean’s eccentric inhabitants, whose mischievous stories range from silly escapades to chaotic adventures. In Sea Sniffers, quirky quests weave together a blend of RPG-progression and offbeat storytelling.
title: Sea Sniffers - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Full Belly Breakout, a first-person, decision-based adventure game developed by Zxima.llc. Players will seek out what lies among the plethora of dishes to enjoy every bite and ultimately escape their cell. Full Belly Breakout is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Full Belly Breakout - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Console Announcement Trailer for Everwind, an open-world survival action RPG developed by Enjoy Studio. Players can explore a sprawling world to gather resources, loot, and take out enemies to seek the truth of the world. Everwind is available now on PC (Steam), with a release on consoles coming soon.
title: Everwind - Official Console Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay and the fantasy world of WildMagic Frontier in this latest trailer for the character-driven, deck-building tactics RPG designed to capture the creativity, strategy, and camaraderie of tabletop game night. Playable directly in a browser, WildMagic Frontier invites players into Astara, a verdant world reawakened by volatile wild magic. Adventurers from across countless realms arrive through mysterious portals to explore the Frontier, uncover ancient secrets, and face dark forces that never truly disappeared. A Kickstarter campaign for WildMagic Frontier is live now.
title: WildMagic Frontier - Official Kickstarter Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Crash Bandicoot 30th Anniversary Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale developed by Epic Games. Players can ring in Crash's 30th birthday by using his skin in Fortnite. Crash is available now in Fortnite.
title: Fortnite x Crash Bandicoot - Official 30th Anniversary Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Nailcrown, a dark fantasy boomer shooter developed by Destructive Creations. Players will shoot through waves of enemies from level to level with an arsenal of weapons. Drench enemies in their blood in Nailcrown, coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Nailcrown - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Tape 101: Liminal Descent will be available on Steam on September 18, 2026. Watch the latest Tape 101: Liminal Descent trailer for another look at this psychological liminal horror game that sends you into a world of repeating corridors, empty offices, tiled passageways, and spaces that become increasingly detached from reality as you descend deeper. Built around the Kübler-Ross model of grief - denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - Tape 101 turns psychological states into physical places.
title: Tape 101: Liminal Descent - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for After the Wane, a stylistic visual novel adventure developed by Nova-box. Players will explore a love story packed with heartbreak, dancing, and a web of decisions to make along the way. After the Wane is launching on November 10 for PC (Steam and GoG).
title: After the Wane - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Shroom and Gloom is available now in Steam Early Access. Step into the dungeon in this Shroom and Gloom early access launch trailer for the double-deck-building dungeon crawler game. 

In Shroom and Gloom, descend into the fungus-infected, hand-drawn depths of the freakiest dungeons you’ve ever seen in this unique roguelike, drawing from hundreds of cards across two distinct decks – Combat and Explore – to battle grotesque, mushroomy monstrosities.

Every enemy you encounter is edible, every attack is infinitely upgradeable and every run is an opportunity for unprecedented levels of card-based chaos.
title: Shroom and Gloom - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Cinderline is a surreal exploration game where you drive your small train as an anthropomorphic bird, exploring strange towns as you journey to create the last S'MORE and bring its youthful delight to the Heart of the aging system. Check out the Cinderline trailer to meet strange characters and more. Cinderline will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Cinderline - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Emissary, a turn-based dark fantasy RPG developed by Weevil Workshop. Players will take on enemies across a stylized world to overcome challenges and restore the world from the brink of oblivion. Emissary is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Emissary - Official Reveal Trailer

description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Huglings, a cozy co-op adventure game developed by Cuddlecados. Players will set out to restore a peaceful village to its original serene condition. Craft items, decorate the town, and live the life of leisure. Huglings is launching on September 17 for PC (Steam).
title: Huglings - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for The Merlies, a 2D exploration platformer developed by Darjeeling and ARTE France. Players will assume control of a flock of tiny but mighty birds on an adventure across a post-apocalyptic world. Harness special abilities, collect scraps, and explore scenic and stylized locations. The Merlies is launching on September 29 for Nintendo Switch, Mac, and PC (Steam).
title: The Merlies - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Mad Ever After, a co-op fantasy first-person roguelike shooter developed by Fubu Games. Players will fight through fantastical realms with magic-based staffs, powerful spells, and larger-than-life bosses to handle. Mad Ever After is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Mad Ever After - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Starfinder: Afterlight, an upcoming party-based sci-fi RPG developed by Epictellers Entertainment. Players will explore a fantasy-science world with a crew to customize builds, engage in tactical combat, and save the galaxy from certain doom. Starfinder: Afterlight is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Starfinder: Afterlight - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Karjala, a psychological horror adventure game developed by UWEG. Players will embody a private of the Soviet Army who is deployed through a portal to search for a lost scientist. Dispatch monsters, traverse a suite of levels, and find a way back home. Karjala is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Karjala - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Feeding the Future DLC Launch Trailer for Surviving Mars: Relaunched, a sci-fi city-building simulation game developed by Haemimont Games. Players can now access a new DLC that allows them to cultivate a diet perfect for Martian life with a variety of delicacies and local production. The Feeding the Future DLC for Surviving Mars: Relaunched is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Official Feeding the Future DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer for SlashZero, a side-scrolling action platformer developed by Streetlamp Studio. Players will fight across time to learn combat skills, traverse a cyberpunk world, and take out the Lord of the Void in the process. SlashZero is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: SlashZero - Official Gameplay Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Season 6 Multiplayer Maps Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest addition to the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Treyarch. Players can get a look at the Multiplayer maps launching with Season 6, including Quantum, Bloodstead, and a suite of maps for the T.E.D.D. Trials limited-time mode. Season 6 launches on September 17 in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Official Season 6 Multiplayer Maps Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero & The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure collection is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero & The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure launch trailer for this RPG collection, featuring both games in this package. Both RPGs can support up to 120 FPS. Alternatively, they can be played in 4K resolution. You can also swap between original and upscaled textures.

When Lloyd Bannings is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section, he and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome injustice in a city gripped by corruption.
title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure - Official PS5 and Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Story Pack 2 & Loveless Launch Trailer for Bordelands 4, the hit first-person action looter shooter RPG developed by Gearbox. Players can now access the FL4K and the Last Resort Story Pack 2 to rescue Mr. Chew from the Tediore Corporation and the latest Vault Hunter, with Loveless the Hacker making her debut in the game. Story Pack 2 & Loveless are available now for Borderlands 4 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Borderlands 4 - Official Story Pack 2 & Loveless Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Mobile Reveal Trailer for Dome Keeper, an action sci-fi roguelike developed by Bippinbits. Players can dig into the depths of the planet to secure resources, upgrade equipment, and fend off enemies seeking to destroy the dome. Dome Keeper is coming soon to iOS and Android.
title: Dome Keeper - Official Mobile Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Teaser Trailer for Five Signals, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Dark Games DDG. Players will receive a cryptic call from their deceased wife, giving coordinates to a location. Navigate abandoned locations, solve puzzles, and seek the truth by any means necessary. Five Signals is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Five Signals - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Meet The Cast' Behind the Scenes Video for Control Resonant, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Remedy. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at the stacked cast for Control Resonant, with Courtney Hope and Sean Durrie portraying siblings Jesse and Dylan Faden, respectively. Hear how they brought the characters to life in Control Resonant, launching on September 24 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Mac, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Control Resonant - Official 'Meet The Cast' Behind the Scenes Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Version 1.0 of The Crust is available now on PC. Check out the latest trailer for The Crust to see what you can expect from this strategy sim game. In The Crust, build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.
title: The Crust - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline, a first-person puzzle adventure game developed by ONE-O-ONE Games. Players will explore a new take on Dante Alighieri's The Divine Comedy by ensuring the gates of Hell are sealed once and for all. Uncover dark secrets of the past in The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Clive in this latest Final Fantasy Resonance trailer for the upcoming RPG. Battle alongside Clive in Final Fantasy Resonance. Resonate with his Vision within the Sanctum of Light and unleash his abilities in combat. Final Fantasy Resonance will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on October 22, 2026.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Clive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Lil Wayne Reveal Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale game developed by Epic Games. Players can hop out of the Battle Bus with one of the great legends of hip-hop, Lil Wayne. Access Lil Wayne's skin in Fortnite on September 12.
title: Fortnite - Official Lil Wayne Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Map Showcase Trailer for Terminal War, an upcoming third-person action shooter developed by Albatross Interactive. Players will fight in an America on its knees as civil war leaves cities struggling to survive amid gunfights and disarray. Check out a suite of maps for Terminal War, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Terminal War - Official Map Showcase Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch and Mobile Release Date Trailer for The Posthumous Investigation, a detective adventure game developed by Mother Gaia Studio. Players will have a singular day to solve a murder case by way of studying a time loop. Interview 14 different characters, study and manipulate their routines, and stay one step ahead. The Posthumous Investigation is launching on September 17 for iOS, Android, and Nintendo Switch.
title: The Posthumous Investigation - Official Nintendo Switch and Mobile Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Intro Cinematic for Valheim, an open-world survival crafting game developed by Iron Gates AB. Players will set out across a procedurally generated world to build, slay enemies, and become a true Viking along the way. Don't miss the Intro Cinematic for Valheim, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Mac, and PC (Steam, Microsoft, and Humble).
title: Valheim - Official Intro Cinematic

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Update 0.6 Launch Trailer for Assetto Corsa Rally, a simulation racing game developed by Supernova Games Studios. Players can now gain access to the latest Update 0.6, packed with Photo Mode, Private Lobbies, new Rally Events, and new cars, including the 1980 Audi Quattro Gr.4, 1999 Peugeot 206 WRC, and 2018 Volkswagen Polo GTI R5. Update 0.6 for Assetto Corsa Rally is now available for PC (Steam).
title: Assetto Corsa Rally - Official Update 0.6 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at the characters and learn more about the story of Code Vein 2: Mask of Idris in this launch trailer for the action RPG's DLC. When every choice can change the future, what will you sacrifice to save everything? The time to right past and future wrongs is now. The Code Vein 2: Mask of Idris DLC is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam.
title: Code Vein 2: Mask of Idris - Official DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take another look at turn-based, tactical gameplay from Ex Sanguis in this Early Access launch trailer for the strategy game from the creators of Othercide. In Ex Sanguis, bleed the world back to life in a series of tactical, turn-based bloodbaths! Lead your Stillae, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Slay foes, kick them back on the timeline, and trigger chain events where elegance and blood flow as one. Ex Sanguis is available now in Steam Early Access.
title: Ex Sanguis - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Game Pass Trailer for Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage, a 3D action fighting game developed by RGG Studio. Players can fight for victory across the single-player World Stage mode, multiplayer modes, and more, with modern features such as cross-play and rollback netcode. Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage is available now on Xbox Game Pass alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage - Official Game Pass Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Aventurine Waveflair in this latest Honkai: Star Rail trailer for the space fantasy RPG. Honkai: Star Rail is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (HoYoPlay and Epic Games Store).
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Aventurine Waveflair Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the voice cast, new features, and get a deep dive into the gameplay, exploration, and combat of Muramasa: Revenant Blades in this latest trailer for the upcoming revival of the classic side-scrolling action-RPG, Muramasa: Rebirth. Muramasa: Revenant Blades will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and Windows PC via Steam on February 4, 2027.

Muramasa: Revenant Blades features new localization, including English voiceover. It also features 4K resolution, new combat and weapon systems, as well as additional modes and gameplay options. Muramasa: Revenant Blades will also feature original protagonists Momohime and Kisuke alongside Okoi, Gonbe, Arashimaru, and Rajaki – all originally introduced in the PlayStation Vita version – allowing players to experience all six unique storylines in any order they choose from the start.
title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for Just Dance: Decades of Hits, the latest installment in the dancing simulation game developed by Ubisoft. Players can dance to the beat of iconic songs across time, from the legendary 1970s to the modern 2020s. Just Dance: Decades of Hits is launching on October 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, with a release on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 10.
title: Just Dance: Decades of Hits - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Minato Gameplay Overview Trailer for Dead or Alive 6: Last Round, a 3D action fighting game developed by Koei Tecmo Games. Players can get the rundown on the newest fighter coming to the game, with Minato joining the roster. Minato leverages her dancing background to land hits from every angle to overwhelm any opponent in her way. Fight as Minato in Dead or Alive 6: Last Round now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Dead or Alive 6: Last Round - Official Minato Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for RAILRIDERS, a fast-paced 1-4 player co-op shooter where you ride a moving train into a dieselpunk frontier overrun by hordes of cryptids. Jump off to complete dangerous contracts, survive relentless enemies, and fight your way back aboard with your crew. RAILRIDERS is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: RAILRIDERS - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the charming world of Woodo in this launch trailer for this upcoming cozy puzzle game. Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing puzzle-tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas. A toy for those who never forgot how to be a child. Woodo will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 16, 2026.
title: Woodo - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this weapon breakdown trailer for the Insect Glaive in Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance, the upcoming DLC expansion to Capcom's latest Monster Hunter title! 
Promising acrobatic multihitting strikes that allow you to stay close to your prey while dishing out the damage, evading their strikes, the Insect Glaive is perfect for Hunters who want mobility with their damage! 

Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance launches on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Insect Glaive Weapon Breakdown Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this live-action trailer for Marvel's Wolverine! Unleash the rage and slash through enemies with Wolverine's signature claws in this all new action game developed by Insomniac Games. 

Marvel's Wolverine launches on PlayStation 5 (PS5) September 15th.
title: Marvel's Wolverine - Official Live-Action Trailer
